issue.title: BUG: Allow 'apply' to be used with non-numpy-dtype DataFrames

repository.name: pandas
repository.description: Flexible and powerful data analysis / manipulation library for Python, providing labeled data structures similar to R data.frame objects, statistical functions, and much more

issue.body: Addresses issue in #12244 in which a non-numpy-dtype for DataFrame.values causes a `TypeError` to be thrown in the `reduce == True` case for `DataFrame.apply`.  Resolved by first passing `DataFrame.values` through `Series` initialization and taking its `values` attribute, which is an `ndarray` and hence will have a valid `dtype`.  Note that the output of `apply` will still have the original `dtype`.
